name: VinDAX
rootCause: Vietnamese cryptocurrency exchange VinDAX has been hacked, losing at least $500,000 in cryptocurrency.

descriptions.text: Vietnamese cryptocurrency exchange VinDAX has been hacked, losing at least $500,000 in cryptocurrency.

VinDAX, a Vietnam-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange, disclosed in November 2019 that attackers had withdrawn roughly $500,000 worth of assets across 23 cryptocurrencies. Public reporting confirms the losses and the exchange’s temporary suspension of deposits and withdrawals, but no detailed technical postmortem, attacker addresses, or verified on-chain theft transactions were published. The exact intrusion path was never publicly disclosed. Contemporary reporting and later incident catalogues describe a compromise of exchange-controlled wallets or infrastructure credentials that enabled unauthorized withdrawals from VinDAX hot wallets.
